**Decoding fictional characters**

I need to think about fictional male characters in cinema related to conflict and weapons, possibly with a black theme. Darth Vader comes to mind, as he’s a well-known male movie character who uses a weapon—his lightsaber. Batman also fits somewhat, but Darth Vader is much stronger in this context. I could consider Zorro too, but I realize these are just guesses! I might express this in JSON format later.
